---
title: "`database_info()` — provenance for one collection"
---

## Purpose

Print the source, license and description for a single registered gene-set
collection, and return its registry row invisibly for programmatic use.

## When to use

Before committing a database to a published figure: check its license terms and
source, or confirm the species and type match your design.

## How it works

Looks up `name` in the registry returned by
[`list_databases`](list_databases.qmd). If no row matches it aborts and points
you back to `list_databases()`. Otherwise it prints a `cli` header and a
definition list of Type, Species, Source, License and Description, then returns
the matching registry row invisibly so it can be captured in code.

## Parameters & defaults

| Argument | Default | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | *(required)* | database token; one of `list_databases()$name` |

## Literature

No method-specific citation; see [methods](../methods.qmd). The per-collection
reference is in the registry's `citation_key` field.

## Example

```r
database_info("hallmark")                  # prints provenance + license
row <- database_info("reactome")           # also returns the row invisibly
row$license
```
